hypotheses.binder: (hf : MDifferentiableAt I I' f ((extChartAt I α).symm z))
hypotheses.justification: Split on hf; the positive case uses the existing proof. Otherwise put c = extChartAt I α and x = c.symm z. The composite f ∘ c.symm cannot be MDifferentiableWithinAt on range I at z: composing with c using MDifferentiableWithinAt.comp_of_eq and mdifferentiableAt_extChartAt would make f differentiable within c.source at x, by c.left_inv. Since c.source is a neighborhood of x, MDifferentiableWithinAt.mdifferentiableAt would contradict ¬hf. Thus mfderiv_zero_of_not_mdifferentiableAt and mfderivWithin_zero_of_not_mdifferentiableWithinAt make both relevant derivatives zero. After inChartAt_apply and mpullback_apply, both sides evaluate the same form on the same zero tuple. This also handles k = 0 (the tuple is empty, without claiming the form vanishes), trivial spaces, and boundary points because differentiation remains within range I.
